description: This file contains unit tests for the MedicationDispenseService in the OpenMRS project, focusing on retrieval, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and deletion of MedicationDispense objects, using the JUnit 5 framework.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing MedicationDispenseService methods including CRUD operations, void/unvoid, and criteria-based retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by loading dataset and updating search index before each test.

methods.name: getMedicationDispense_shouldGetExistingMedicationDispense
methods.description: Tests retrieving a MedicationDispense by ID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid_shouldGetExistingMedicationDispense
methods.description: Tests retrieving a MedicationDispense by UUID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldGetByPatient
methods.description: Tests retrieving MedicationDispenses filtered by patient.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldGetByEncounter
methods.description: Tests retrieving MedicationDispenses filtered by encounter.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldGetByDrugOrder
methods.description: Tests retrieving MedicationDispenses filtered by drug order.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria_shouldIncludedVoided
methods.description: Tests retrieval of both voided and non-voided MedicationDispenses.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense_shouldNotChangeVoidedPropertiesIfAlreadyVoided
methods.description: Tests that voiding an already voided MedicationDispense does not alter properties.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense_shouldFailIfVoidReasonIsNull
methods.description: Ensures voiding fails if void reason is null.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense_shouldFailIfVoidReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures voiding fails if void reason is empty.

methods.name: unvoidMedicationDispense_shouldUnvoidSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests unvoiding a previously voided MedicationDispense.

methods.name: purgeMedicationDispense_shouldRemoveFromDatabase
methods.description: Tests deleting a MedicationDispense from the database.
